t: Portion Size Versus Serving Size | American Heart Association
s: Portion size and serving size are often used interchangeably, but they have a distinct and important difference. Portion size is the amount of food you choose to put on your plate and actually eat. Serving size is the amount of a specific food or drink that people typically consume.
